scientific_integrity.new_scope: Stationary exponential-moment divergence and quantitative non-Gaussian far-tail obstruction at every finite bath friction.
scientific_integrity.prior_components_credited: Underlying Langevin equations, reset model, reset-free variance and quasistatic Gaussian mixture are from Santra and Das (arXiv:2603.17027v1).
scientific_integrity.proof_status: Analytic proof plus finite algebraic verification; no independent audit.

scientific_limitations: The exponential-probability lower bound is not a matching asymptotic; an exact finite-bath-memory tail rate is not claimed.
Divergence of the probe moment-generating function is established at and above a specific threshold, not its finiteness below that threshold.
The frozen-bath mixture is a separately defined comparator; convergence to it from finite memory is not proved.
Only the dimensionless one-bath linear stochastic model with independent position-only Poisson resetting is covered.
title: Finite-memory exponential-tail obstruction for a partially reset viscoelastic probe
